notes.title: Build notes 1.6.00 - Multiclass Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]
- Added a new light item Selective Stone!
  This allows you to select the Item Sets you want to spawn throughout the game.
- Added 10+ new items
- Added 15+ new achievements

[h2]Bug fix[/h2]
- Fixed bugs with Precious
- Fixed resurrection bugs
- Sentimental Value achievement does not consider the light item equipped
- Fixes for loading into some boss rooms on Hard mode

[h2]Balance[/h2]
- Cursed Bounty is now Multiclass

We hope to share more news and start testing on the [url=https://discord.gg/twicedifferent]Twice Different Discord[/url] in the near future.
Thanks for your support!
Simon and Mess @ Twice Different

Hi all, this is a small patch to update the Twice Different logo and [url=https://discord.gg/twicedifferent]Discord[/url] links as we approach the announcement of our next game!

This patch also include a fix for UI text not appearing on M1 Macs and recent OS. 
There's still a known graphical issue with the News Feed on new Mac OS, however this should significantly improve the experience for our Mac players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440393/60649f92b4da38ad6516b8c398e44f6f6209bd64.jpg[/img]

Our Discord server is now a studio server.
We've decided to keep our communities together as we're generally interested in making dark strategy games for a similar type of player. 

If you'd like to [url=https://discord.gg/twicedifferent]be a part of our Discord community[/url] it's a great place to get the latest news and we also run events.

notes.title: Team update from Twice Different
notes.notes:
Hello friends! 
I wanted to share some news from the Twice Different team. ːRoPFrogː

First up, we're so grateful to have found some success with Ring of Pain which has enabled us to add a ton of free extra content since launch. I've mentioned in the past that we've been uncertain about adding more content due to our focus being on our next dark strategy game... However, I have some news!

We've decided to give our community an opportunity to be a part of another small content update.

[h2]Item design challenge[/h2]

On our Discord we've just started an item design challenge with a brief. We're interested in adding some synergies for item sets and making content inspired by the community.

This is a chance to get your idea into the game!
We'll be running this event until mid April so check the #events channel on [url=https://discord.gg/ringofpain]Discord[/url] for more information.


[h2]Upcoming game announcement[/h2]

We're also getting close to being able to announce our next project, and we'll be figuring out a plan to do some community testing this year (hopefully pretty soon).

We'll be expanding our Discord to include the next title we're working on as well, so if you're interested in knowing more, [url=https://discord.gg/ringofpain]join us on Discord[/url] and all will be revealed soon... 

Thanks for playing!
Simon and Mess
Twice Different

[h2]10+ new achievements[/h2]

notes.title: Build notes 1.3.06f2 - Twitch bugfix, and welcome new players!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Welcome to our new players! It's been a busy month so far and we hope you're enjoying our game so far.

Our community is always happy to help you get the most out of it, and to learn more about the mechanics, a good starting point is this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/998740/discussions/0/3002172678255247257/]Strategy Tips post in the discussion forum[/url]. Or feel free to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/ringofpain]Discord![/url]

[h3]Bugfix[/h3]
This patch is a small fix to Twitch extension features with item drawings occasionally getting stuck.

Thanks to everyone who's streamed our game! Do check out the Twitch features via the in-game Twitch button if you haven't already. We wanted to make a creative way for your streaming audience to engage with you.

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
We have new features and content being tested in the Beta branch, including mid-game save, a Bestiary and new items. 

We're working to get this ready for release this year, hopefully next month. We're a small indie team and trying to make sure it's solid. Thanks everyone who's reported bugs and provided feedback so far.
Stay tuned for more details!

notes.title: Beta update 1.3.07
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]

[h3]Mid Game Saves[/h3]
We've been working on one of the most requested features since launch: Mid game save. 
Using an exit will now auto-save your current run so it can be continued from the title screen if you close the game or return to the main menu. 

We expect there to be some issues with this, so if you find any inconsistencies or bugs please let us know! 

This feature needs to work perfectly before we can release it in the main game, and this is a test to see how well it performs.

[h3]Overview camera - get a better view of the dungeons[/h3]
This allows you to see the ring from a higher perspective. 
[i]Overview can be activated by:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440393/2445b3519101c5bc5dc9495cdc6f263d55cd1699.jpg[/img]
[h3]We've been working on this since last year. 
It's bigger than all previous updates combined, [i]and it's free![/i][/h3]

[h2]Discover new content and hidden surprises[/h2]
[h3]80+ new items
15+ new creatures
5+ new special rooms
15+ new achievements
15+ new Daily Dungeon modifiers[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440393/f11d7e83d8c80bc8a9e29372e2241989422e311d.png[/img]
[h2]New difficulty and game mode improvements[/h2]
A Medium difficulty has been added to help newer players prepare for our brutal Hard mode.
Medium and Hard difficulty now also introduce new, tougher creatures!

We've also improved the starting items! 
Double Candle lets you choose a common item to begin with, Dark Stone has increased stealth chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440393/297aa4e2e01a7770e2dc75e9f26ca2ade2d88cae.png[/img]
[h2]Player Statistics[/h2]
The Collection now includes a Statistics page to see your gameplay statistics! There 4 different categories for General, Combat, Exploration and Item statistics. Some of these have been tracked previously, and some are new.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440393/241c5c7d10462378ce119020e8ef3a4c2f46ea35.png[/img]
Gameover screen now shows a map of your path taken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440393/6ccd90b2be2bc9d03ac043c5d07fb7694aa39285.png[/img]
[h2]New status effect: Petrify[/h2]
Light Damage has been reworked into Petrify, an effect which reduces maximum health and acts as a permanent debuff. We wanted to give Light Damage a new identity to differentiate it from Soul Damage, and in the future it may also be an interesting debuff on the player with items that can synergise with being Petrified.
Previous Light Damage items have also been updated to use the new effect. 

Plus more bug fixing and improvements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440393/679d384f662288b1efb437a013de25b9015d9f45.jpg[/img]

We're proud of Ring of Pain and our improvements since launch. As a small indie team we took a risk in making a different sort of dungeon crawler game and have been lucky enough to find some success.

This may be the biggest free update we add to the game, and we've worked hard to make it something special for you all.

Community support and sharing helps us afford to make these updates, and if you'd like to help us please review our game.

notes.title: Beta update 1.2.05b
notes.notes:
This is a big one, and includes a lot of new content to test before our next major update!

For this Beta we've replaced the previous set of Beta items with the latest ones, so players have more access to the newest content in the game. This will help us identify bugs and give you all a chance to try them more frequently.

One of the big reworks coming is turning Light Damage into Petrify, and this update includes that change in its work-in-progress form. 
Petrify is similar to damage, except it reduces [i]max[/i] health instead of current health. This will be more significant as more content is added, but helps us distinguish the status effect from being true damage (like Soul Damage).

We've also reworked Double Candle and Dark Stone to be more unique, and Double Candle now lets you choose a common starting item!

Another big addition for testing is Player Statistics page, located in Collection. 
Some of these statistics have been tracked previously and others are new.

More details will come with the full release of this content, for now it's ready in the PC Beta and we hope you enjoy!

[h3]Features[/h3]
- Added new paths that feature new creatures
- Added a new status effect Petrify
- Added a Statistics Page
  This will display your statistics for runs, items, combat events, exploration events
- Display creature effects when inspecting them
  This will display things such as the amount of explosion, poison, ranged damage a creature will deal
- Added new Daily Dungeon modifiers
- Path taken is displayed on the game over screen
- Added Mute game when in another window setting
- Razer Chroma Support
  We have unique animations for each of the 6 supported devices: Keyboard, Mouse, Mousepad, Keypad, Headset and ChromaLink. We're interested in what you think! Also feel welcome to post your gaming rigs testing it out 😎

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
- Show end game choice on game over screen
- Candles that are unlocked through achievements are displayed on the achievements page
- The map hotkey can now be bound to another key
- Added Up button when hovering over certain cards
- Added controller tutorial for observing previously explored paths
- Twitch drawings can be swapped to the original creature drawings in-game

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a bug where a card in the centre of the ring stays on screen after the level is completed
- Fixed speech issues with the Ravaged Room
- Fire Breeds can no longer spawn an exploder after dying
- Hovering over creatures will now show their souls
- Fixed a bug that would unlock the spoon achievement
- Fixed issues with the collection's scrollbar not resizing
- Fixed issues with non-english text causing issues in-game
- Fixed issues when using a Spellbook or Scroll over the Creature card's inspect icon
- Adjusted stat manipulation calculation and how it can be absorbed
  Clearer projections when losing stats from items like Siphon Gem
- Fixed issues with Crown of Clarity
- Polearm + Knockback now works with the projection system

[h3]Balance[/h3]
- Double Candle now allows you to select a common-tier starting item, Stealth chance removed
- Dark Stone starts with Barrier scroll, Stealth change increased 30% -> 40%, Speed reduced -1 -> -2
- Necklace Rebirth cures poison.
- Metal Ox stats increased 0 -> 4 Health, 0 -> 4 Clarity
- Chestplate explode damage reduction changed from half to reduce by 2. (Chestplate's previous item effect will be used on a Legendary item which isn't in the game yet)
- Special path balance
  Fountain of Life reduced spawn rate in early game
  Careful Maneuvre and Overwhelm can no longer spawn in the first level
  Companions Sam can appear a little earlier
- The timer starts counting up when the player has control
  Previously it would start when the tutorial started or the starting camera animation

[h3]Other[/h3]
- The "Trinket" item slot has been renamed to "Jar"

notes.title: Build notes 1.2.02 - Balance patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Difficulty tuning patch[/h3]

We'll continue to adjust the game as we add more content and features. 
Hard mode is significantly more difficult than Normal mode, but we've tuned mid and late game areas with this update for more consistency, and to give you more access to loot. 

It's still very important to save and manage souls in Hard mode. Buying all chests will mean you're unable to afford higher tier loot and scale your build, which is crucial for survival, and planning multiple turns ahead to maximise your resources and use the dungeon against itself.

Hard mode balance:
[list]
[*] Removed Fire Breed from depth 9.
[*] Slight increase to Poisonbead and Firebead spawn rate in middle levels for more environmental damage.
[*] Increased Chest/Corpse quality in depths before most shops. If you can't afford a chest you may still be able to buy a shop item.
[*] Ravaged room can appear slightly earlier.
[*] Made lower tier monsters spawn slightly later as well for more soul farming.
[/list]

Item balance:
Dark Pants: Added 5% Crit Chance.

We'll be doing some more item balance soon. 
Thanks for playing and providing feedback!

notes.title: The Specialist Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The Specialist Update is here![/h1]

As we introduce new features, our long term goal is to make the game more strategic and create more versatile play styles. They're also a step towards the new game mode we're working on.

Giving players more agency over the game means the difficulty may change as we tune it, and if players have more ways to master the game it provides a path for us to create more hardcore, challenging content in the future!

This update includes a very important feature:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440393/f95fbd8d1cecca13ba1d553563516d238a7ca7ca.jpg[/img]

[h2]Choosable Stat Boosts[/h2]

There are now multiple types of Stat Boosts with different effects! 
These also give you a choice between 1 of 3 stats to gain, to help you balance your build the way you want!

[h3]New Stat Boost types are:[/h3]
[b]Basic[/b] - Choose 1 of 3 primary Stats to increase
[b]Compromise[/b] - Choose 1 of 3 primary Stat to increase, -1 to the other 2 choices
[b]Specialised[/b] - Choose 1 of 3 primary Stat to increase a lot, -1 to all other stats

The Basic type can also appear as a Cursed Stat Boost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440393/cee414487153d403f77901cd2e7d400b94d4f580.jpg[/img]

[h2]15+ New items[/h2]
As we continue adding content we're aiming to keep filling out areas which need more variety, as well as adding more synergies to make existing items more useful! This is a long term goal for us, though we're excited to share our first batch of new items.

These includes the beginning of spell cast synergies, more versatile Stalker set cards and a special frog-related treat...
We won't spoil too much, so you can discover the new items yourself. 

[h2]10+ New achievements[/h2]
Over time we'll be adding a mix of Achievements for you to naturally unlock over the course of playing Ring of Pain, as well as more specific challenges which require extra thought.

Thank you to all players for your support, feedback, and sharing. 
We're excited to keep building the game, and will continue tuning the experience. We welcome any thoughts and feel free to join our discussions on [url=https://discord.gg/ringofpain]Discord[/url].
